summary: Built a 13-chapter learn page with 25+ live demos that teaches a scroll-driven WebGL site. The headline lesson: several 'done' moments weren't done — a check that silently never ran, and layout bugs that only showed at phone width.

evidence.text: The type-check was wrapped in a 'timeout' command that doesn't exist on macOS, so it printed 'done' without running. The real run later found 5 type errors.
The host site's CSS reset unsets <pre> and scales the root font size with the window, so all rem-based spacing on the new page came out ~60% of the intended size.
A stylesheet imported inside a lazily loaded chunk went missing after a hot reload; the page showed unstyled until a full reload.
React's development double-mount triggered a shape change whose 'kill all tweens of this object' also killed the gather tween; particles stayed as a cloud.
An animation frame read a React ref after the component unmounted (null.style).
Hidden glossary tooltips near the right edge widened the phone layout: page width 467px on a 375px screen.
13 lint errors at the end: setState inside effects, '//////' text read as a comment, callbacks returning promises.
The browser preview was hidden, so screenshots failed; switched to DOM checks and a headless browser.
The dev server port belonged to another session; worked around by attaching to the running server.
Learn pages should default to the chapter-guide style (tabs, demos with dials, flashcards, quiz).
Stronger curves are allowed only in an 'immersive site' mode; special effects are opt-in by name.
Explain in plain language and ask before any design decision.
Headless browser on the real GPU scrolled the whole page with a draw-call counter: 60fps, 16–28 draw calls, flat memory after 3 returns.
One shared canvas harness (resize, pointer, pause off screen, dispose) kept 20+ WebGL demos consistent and leak-free.
An overflow scan across every tab at 375px and 1440px found the tooltip bug in one pass.

corrected: Default learn-page style is the chapter guide (E10)
Immersive-site mode for stronger curves; effects only when named (E11)
Plain language, ask before design decisions (E12)
broke: Host CSS reset shrank spacing on the new page (E2)
Lazy-chunk stylesheet lost on hot reload (E3)
Dev double-mount killed an unrelated tween (E4)
Frame loop read a ref after unmount (E5)
Lint errors left to the end (E7)
worked: Headless GPU scroll measurement with a draw-call counter (E13)
One canvas harness for every demo (E14)

proposals.title: Prove each check actually ran
proposals.why: A silent check looked like a passing check, and errors reached the end.
proposals.after: - [ ] Every check that printed nothing was confirmed to have run (exit code, or a known-bad input fails it)

proposals.title: Overflow scan at phone and desktop width
proposals.why: One script found a sideways-scroll bug that screenshots missed.
proposals.after: For each page/tab at 375px and 1440px: report documentElement.scrollWidth and the first elements whose right edge passes the viewport (ignoring scroll containers).

proposals.title: Hidden tooltips widen phones
proposals.why: Invisible elements still take space; the page scrolled sideways on phones.
proposals.after: | Hidden tooltip near the edge | Page scrolls sideways at 375px | overflow-x: clip on the page root (keeps sticky working) |

proposals.title: Killing all tweens of an object
proposals.why: Stopping one animation silently stopped another on the same object.
proposals.after: gsap.killTweensOf(obj) kills every tween on obj. Pass the properties: killTweensOf(obj, 'morph,burst'). In dev, effects run twice: compare keys instead of 'skip first run'.

proposals.title: Check the host site's CSS reset first
proposals.why: The new page inherited rules that shrank its spacing and broke code blocks.
proposals.after: Before styling, read the global reset: root font-size, pre/blockquote resets. Scope fixes to the page (html:has(.page-root) { font-size: 16px }).

proposals.title: Frame loops never read React refs
proposals.why: A frame after unmount crashed the demo.
proposals.after: Frame callbacks use the element and objects captured at setup, never ref.current.

proposals.title: Default learn-page style
proposals.why: The designer picked a default during this project.
